title: charlesfoster/wasteline pipeline parameters
description: Wastewater SARS-CoV-2 lineage abundance pipeline (Illumina amplicon, Freyja)

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a comma-separated samplesheet. Columns depend on `--mode`: `full` sample,fastq_1,fastq_2; `demix` sample,variants,depths; `aggregate` sample,demix. All modes accept optional sample_type,collection_date,site (fastp_json too for `demix`).
input.help_text: Required by `--mode full`; optional for `demix` (alternative: `--previous_results`) and `aggregate` (alternatives: `--demix_dir`, `--previous_results`); not used by `report` and `update_db`. `sample` may only contain letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-` and is never rewritten. `sample_type` is `sample` (default) or `negative`; `collection_date` is ISO `YYYY-MM-DD`. The columns are validated against assets/schema_input.json (full), assets/schema_input_demix.json or assets/schema_input_aggregate.json. See docs/usage.md.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

mode.help_text: `full`: FASTQ to aggregated Freyja results. `demix`: re-run `freyja demix` (e.g. with newer barcodes) on existing variants/depths files, then aggregate. `aggregate`: aggregate existing `.demix` files only. `report`: rebuild the HTML report of a previous run (`--results_dir`, written to a different `--outdir`). `update_db`: download the latest Freyja data into `--db_dir` and exit.

previous_results.description: Modes `demix`/`aggregate`: results directory (or several, comma-separated) of an earlier run, from wasteline or from the legacy Snakemake pipeline. Never modified.
previous_results.help_text: Both layouts are detected per sample: `samples/<sample>/freyja/` (wasteline) and `<sample>/freyja/` (Snakemake). Gzipped legacy variants files are handled. Alternative to `--input`; discovery uses `bin/make_samplesheet.py --from-results`, and `sample_type`, `collection_date` and `site` are carried over from the results' `summary/samplesheet.csv` when present (otherwise IDs matching `NEG_|NC_` are negative controls).

demix_dir.description: Mode `aggregate`: directory searched (recursively) for `*.demix` files. The sample ID is the file name without `.demix`.
demix_dir.help_text: Alternative to `--input`. IDs matching `NEG_|NC_` are treated as negative controls.

results_dir.description: Mode `report`: results directory of a previous run. Needs `pipeline_info/run_info.json`; `summary/report_data.json` is reused when present, otherwise rebuilt from the other files in `summary/`. `--outdir` must differ from it.

include_negatives_in_aggregate.description: Include negative controls (`sample_type=negative`) in `freyja aggregate` and the plots.
include_negatives_in_aggregate.help_text: Negative controls that pass the coverage gate are always demixed and listed in `demix_status.tsv`, but by default they are kept out of the aggregate and plots (PLAN D8).

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

library_protocol_options.title: Library protocol
library_protocol_options.description: How the reads were made: PCR amplicons (primer-trimmed) or probe capture (not trimmed).

protocol.description: Library protocol. `amplicon` (default): tiled PCR amplicons, reads are primer-trimmed. `capture`: probe-capture libraries (e.g. Twist): no primer trimming, no amplicon-dropout analysis, PCR duplicates are marked.
protocol.help_text: With `capture`, `--primer_scheme` and `--primer_bed` are ignored (with a warning). The protocol is recorded in run_info.json and shown in the report header.

skip_primer_trimming.description: Do not primer-trim (`ivar trim`). For reads that are already trimmed. Implied by `--protocol capture`. Amplicon-level QC is off too: `--primer_scheme`/`--primer_bed` are ignored.

duplicates.description: PCR-duplicate handling after alignment. `mark`: flag duplicates (`samtools markdup`); Freyja's pileup then ignores them. `none`: leave them. `auto`: `mark` for `--protocol capture`, `none` for `amplicon`.
duplicates.help_text: Duplicates are flagged, never removed. Not used by modes without reads (`demix`, `aggregate`).

reference_and_primer_options.title: Reference and primer options
reference_and_primer_options.description: Reference genome and amplicon primer scheme.

fasta.description: Path to the reference FASTA. Default: the bundled reference (conf/pathogens/sars2.config).
fasta.help_text: The BWA index is built from this file once per run.

gff.description: Path to the reference annotation (GFF3). Default: the bundled annotation.

primer_scheme.description: Bundled amplicon primer scheme (assets/primer_schemes/). Default: `midnight` in mode `full`.
primer_scheme.help_text: Ignored if `--primer_bed` is given. The `swift` scheme implies `--ivar_offset 5`. In mode `demix` the scheme of the old results is unknown, so per-amplicon coverage is only computed when `--primer_scheme` or `--primer_bed` is given explicitly.

primer_bed.help_text: The contig name must match the reference FASTA. With a custom BED the ivar offset defaults to 0; set `--ivar_offset` if needed.

ivar_offset.description: `ivar trim -x` primer position offset. Default: 5 for the bundled `swift` scheme, otherwise 0.

pathogen.description: Freyja `--pathogen` name (set by conf/pathogens/*.config). Only SARS-CoV-2 is implemented.
pathogen.errorMessage: Only --pathogen SARS-CoV-2 is implemented and validated (reference, primers, Freyja dataset names are SARS-CoV-2 specific).

read_trimming_and_bam_options.title: Read trimming and BAM options
read_trimming_and_bam_options.description: fastp settings (defaults reproduce the Snakemake pipeline) and what to keep.

fastp_length_required.description: fastp `--length_required` (reads shorter than this are discarded).

save_bam.description: Publish the primer-trimmed, sorted BAM and index.

freyja_options.title: Freyja options
freyja_options.description: Freyja barcode data and analysis settings.

barcodes.description: Freyja barcode dataset: `latest`, `container`, a version (`YYYY-MM-DD`, `MM_DD_YYYY-HH-MM` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM`), or a dataset directory / `.csv` / `.feather` file.
barcodes.help_text: `latest` runs `freyja update` and stores the dataset in `--db_dir/freyja/<YYYY-MM-DDTHH-MM>/`. `container` uses the snapshot bundled in the pinned Freyja container (offline). A version resolves a dataset previously stored in `--db_dir` (a bare date picks the newest that day) and errors if none exists. A path is used verbatim (version recorded as `custom`). The dataset is resolved once so every sample uses the same data; the version and checksums are recorded in `pipeline_info/run_info.json` and `summary/barcode_version.json`.

db_dir.description: Writable directory for downloaded Freyja datasets. Default: `~/.wasteline/db`.

freyja_varthresh.help_text: Freyja's own default (0.0, keep everything). The old Snakemake pipeline used 0.25; this pipeline deliberately does not.

freyja_eps.description: `freyja demix --eps`: minimum abundance reported per lineage.

freyja_covcut.description: `freyja demix --covcut`: depth that counts a site as covered (also used for the coverage gate).

freyja_depthcutoff.description: `freyja demix --depthcutoff`: exclude sites below this depth and group identical barcodes (0 = off).

freyja_autoadapt.description: `freyja demix --autoadapt`: set the adaptive penalty from the sample's error profile.

freyja_solver.description: `freyja demix --solver`: solver for the abundance estimate.

compare_barcodes.description: A second Freyja dataset (same forms as `--barcodes`): every sample is demixed again with it and `summary/barcode_compare.tsv` lists the abundance changes. Modes `full` and `demix`.
compare_barcodes.help_text: Recorded as `freyja_data_compare` in run_info.json. A sample whose second demix fails is flagged, never fatal. Default: off.

freyja_boot.description: Run `freyja boot` per demixed sample: bootstrap 95% intervals (2.5/97.5 percentiles) per lineage in `summary/freyja_boot_summary.tsv`.

freyja_boot_seed.description: Bootstrap seed (`freyja boot --bootseed`); fixed, so reruns give identical intervals.

freyja_plot_mincov.description: `freyja plot --mincov`: minimum genome coverage (%) for a sample to be plotted.

freyja_plot_interval.description: Interval of the time-aware plot (`freyja plot --times`, drawn when samples have a `collection_date`): month (`MS`), week (`W`) or day (`D`).

freyja_plot_windowsize.description: Rolling-average window (days) of the daily (`D`) time-aware plot.

min_genome_coverage_for_demix.description: Skip demixing samples with less than this % of the genome at depth >= `--freyja_covcut`.
min_genome_coverage_for_demix.help_text: Skipped samples are listed in `summary/demix_status.tsv` with status `skipped_low_coverage` and are excluded from the aggregate.

coverage_qc_options.title: Coverage QC and negative controls
coverage_qc_options.description: Per-sample coverage QC from the Freyja depths file (PLAN D7) and negative-control assessment (PLAN D8).

amplicon_min_depth.description: An amplicon is dropped when its mean depth is below this.

qc_min_depth.description: Depth used for the PASS/WARN/FAIL coverage test.

qc_pass_min_pct.description: PASS needs at least this % of the genome at `qc_min_depth`.

qc_fail_below_pct.description: FAIL below this % of the genome at `qc_min_depth`.

qc_max_dropped_amplicons.description: WARN (`amplicon_dropout`) when more amplicons than this dropped. Raise it for schemes with many amplicons (e.g. 10 for 99-amplicon ARTIC).

ntc_max_mapped_reads.description: A negative control FAILs (`ntc_reads`) above this many mapped reads.

ntc_max_genome_coverage_pct.description: A negative control FAILs above this % of the genome at >= 1x.

consensus_options.title: Consensus genomes
consensus_options.description: Per-sample consensus built from the Freyja variants TSV and depths file (PLAN 5.11). Negative controls get none.

skip_consensus.description: Skip the consensus chain and the consensus summaries.

consensus_min_depth.description: Positions below this depth are masked (N); also used for `pct_genome_ge_min_depth`.

consensus_freq.description: SNV ALT_FREQ needed to apply the alternative allele.

indel_freq.description: Indel ALT_FREQ needed to apply it.

consensus_min_depth_variants.description: Minimum TOTAL_DP at a variant (not the mask depth `consensus_min_depth`).

consensus_iupac.description: Write IUPAC codes for ambiguous SNVs; false leaves the reference base.

consensus_iupac_min_af.description: SNV ALT_FREQ must be above this (and below `consensus_freq`) for an IUPAC code.

consensus_iupac_min_alt_reads.description: ALT_DP needed for an IUPAC code.

mutations_of_interest.description: CSV with columns `name,mutation` (e.g. `S:N501Y`, `A23063T`, `C75-`, `A14+C`); frequency and depth per sample go to `summary/mutations_of_interest.tsv`.

annotate_variants.description: Annotate the called variants with their amino-acid consequences (`bcftools csq` with the GFF3): `samples/<s>/variants/<s>.annotated.tsv` and `summary/annotated_variants.tsv`.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

validate_params.description: Boolean whether to validate parameters against the schema at runtime

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
